correctness.rationale: At every visit to A the opposite-class draw is fresh uniform on B, even after restart from root; when the B draw repeats an independent uniform A label follows. This proves independent geometric failures F_r with P(F_r=j)=(1-r/b)(r/b)^j. Coupon inclusion-exclusion produces the exact product CDF for J (including j=0 and the final b boundary). The rare-repeat marked Poisson coupling gives independent Rayleigh first-occupation levels after scaling by sqrt(b); a union bound controls the mean. In the growing-a window, independent coupon collection C_a and geometric collision count M_b(j) with correct moment estimates prove the Gumbel limit under a(log a)^3=o(b). Finite rational comparisons confirm only finite cases, not the limiting statements.
residual_risks: Fixed-a limit is not the growing-a regime; quantitative total variation applies to finite discrete marked count vectors, not continuous times.
